provenance.curation: Agent-curated synthetic queries from checked-in seed content; not human-user or production-traffic labels.
provenance.chunkIdSemantics: Relevant IDs are the original documents[].chunks[].id values in the country JSON seeds. Runtime visa_chunks rows currently have generated UUIDs, so this set is a source-level gold set.
provenance.evidenceSemantics: Each evidence.text value is an exact substring of its source chunk's content and is limited to one or two sentences that support the query.
provenance.negativePolicy: An unanswerable case has no answer chunk under its exact filters, or its purpose is explicitly outside the filtered product. Negative rationale records the local-seed basis; no unsupported requirement is invented.
provenance.selectionPolicy: Tune on dev only. Use heldout once for final comparison. Positive source parents are partitioned between splits to avoid cross-split leakage.
provenance.runtimeFilterNote: Some items intentionally omit visaType while retaining country and documentTypes because runtime normalizes aliases such as DS160, UK_STANDARD_VISITOR, EU_SCHENGEN_C_SHORT_STAY, and ID_C1_TOURIST to values that differ from the seed product codes.

scope: Exact local cosine search over checked-in public country seeds; not the active DB, ANN index, live user traffic, or end-to-end answer quality.
baselineScope: Old vector parameters only; legacy unordered REST fallback is excluded and separately regression-tested.
selectionRule: dev recall >= baseline - 0.02; maximize 0.7 * positive macro F2 + 0.3 * negative abstention; ties: fewer context chars, then smaller k, then lower threshold. Heldout never reselects.
chunkingUnit: Unicode code points in seed content; production metadata retained per piece. Evidence spans must be fully covered by the union of retrieved source intervals; gaps do not count. Precision deduplicates parent sources, not overlap pieces.
embeddingUsageScope: Cumulative real provider receipts for this local cache, including preparation. Batch latency is not per-query or end-to-end retrieval latency.

promotionGate.rule: heldout recall >= baseline - 0.02; F2 >= baseline; negative false-positive rate <= baseline

compatiblePromotionGate.rule: heldout recall >= baseline - 0.02; F2 >= baseline; negative false-positive rate <= baseline
